regions.label: Centered h2 'Your Previous Results' with subtitle and horizontal rule
Date-grouped list of past game results; each row is a full-width bordered button summarizing a chain ('minion to hot dog, slither to noodle, etc.')
Credit line 'Drawphone by Tanner Krewson' and 'View on GitHub' link

evidence.quote: 08:16 PM: minion to hot dog, slither to noodle, etc.
evidence.note: Item view: time + summary of start->end words of each chain; clicking replaces the list with full 'Results #1' drawing chain detail (verified live), which itself contains a 'View more results' list of other chains plus Done button
Time-ordered history, but entries are saved game artifacts to open, not a record of events/actors

structure.layout: single narrow centered column (452px) with heading, long date-grouped list-group of buttons, exit button and footer

aesthetics.typography: Pangolin (handwritten-style rounded sans, Google Font) used for everything: headings, list items, buttons, footer
aesthetics.typeScale: Low contrast: h2 32px, button 20px, everything else 16px regular weight

notes: Bootstrap list-group styling with joined bordered rows (1px #ccc, 4px radius on group ends), all text centered in a narrow 452px column on a white page. The handwritten Pangolin font gives the only character. Each entry's summary reads like 'first word to last word' for each chain, ending with 'etc.'. The detail view (checked live) replaces the list with the drawing chain, a grey summary box 'You started with / ended up with', and a numbered 'View more results' list.
